title: AGB Error Code Registry
description: Centralized error codes shared across Python and Node.js microservices. Error codes follow semantic versioning and are never removed, only deprecated.

versioningStrategy.description: Semantic versioning is used for error codes. MAJOR version changes indicate breaking changes in error structure, MINOR version adds new error codes, PATCH version updates messages or documentation.
versioningStrategy.policy: Error codes are never removed, only marked as deprecated with a deprecatedAt timestamp and replacedBy field pointing to the new error code.

severityLevels.critical: Critical failure, system integrity at risk
